about: Lit as in lighting.json and at work; the board comes up again at 250 s over a dark pot and remembers work: it waits under watch with the auger standing, and the watch has no number while the flame is dark. The flame shows 256-259 s and the watch counts 9 down to 6; a dark second at 260 takes the count away, and the flame from 261 s is watched its whole again.
